plan.schedule: Alternate baseline/atomic ordering per repetition. No profiling concurrent with a capture.
plan.scope: Compare frozen previous record_frame versus current atomic record_frame on identical new source prefixes. All other code unchanged. Serial instrumented replay, never live commit timings.

runs.limitation: Serial unpaced offline prefix; Kalshi-only journal, no other receivers, sampling or network waits. Historical clocks are NOT measured coverage. Commit wall time includes synchronization/checkpoint/scheduling, not isolated device latency.
